method.registry_probe: Single bounded GET https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=<token>&limit=100 per token, 20s timeout, first page only, sequential. count = servers.length on page 1; capped=true when the page was full (100) with metadata.nextCursor present. our_rank = 1-based index of the first row whose name matches /theluckystrike/i on that page (null if none). Same style as R5/R6.
method.variant_publish: New registry name io.github.theluckystrike/templates on servers/docx, stdio-only mcpb package, same GitHub release asset URL and fileSha256 as servers/docx/server.mcpb.json's mcpb entry at the time of publish (v0.6.1). Login via `mcp-publisher login github -token "$(gh auth token)"`, publish via `mcp-publisher publish` with server.templates.json copied over server.json for the call, then server.json restored to the original docx manifest. `yes y |` used for prompts.
method.gsc_url_inspection: python3 + google-auth service account /Users/mike/Desktop/keys/gsc-sa-key.json (client_email zovo-gsc-cleanup@zovo-extensions.iam.gserviceaccount.com), scope webmasters.readonly. POST https://searchconsole.googleapis.com/v1/urlInspection/index:inspect with {inspectionUrl, siteUrl: 'sc-domain:zovo.one'} for each of the 5 target URLs.
method.googlebot_anchor_check: curl -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Googlebot/2.1; +http://www.google.com/bot.html)' https://zovo.one/ (server-rendered HTML only, no JS execution), grepped for an <a> tag or href containing mcp.zovo.one.
method.indexnow: POST https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow with host mcp.zovo.one, key from data/indexnow.key, keyLocation https://mcp.zovo.one/<key>.txt, urlList = the 5 target URLs.
method.findable_share: Same formula as data/organic.json and INTEL_R6: p = min(1, 10/our_rank) if our current-version row for that server's own registry name(s) appears on page 1, else 0; mean over the tracked token slots.

googlebot_anchor_check.finding: Zero occurrences of 'mcp.zovo.one' anywhere in the server-rendered HTML. The homepage is a client-rendered React SPA (bundled JS: react-vendor, router, radix-ui, lucide-react, query, supabase) -- any link to mcp.zovo.one, if it exists at all, is injected by client-side JavaScript that Googlebot's HTML fetch (and this curl check) never executes. So the claim that 'zovo.one homepage serves the mcp.zovo.one anchor to a Googlebot user agent' does NOT hold for the raw crawlable response; Google's renderer may pick it up on a second render pass, but the first-pass fetch (what most crawl budget uses) sees no reference to mcp.zovo.one at all.

result_schema.evidence: Part 1: waited for v0.6.1 (git fetch + log poll every 3 min, landed at ~11 min) then published io.github.theluckystrike/templates on docx (same v0.6.1 mcpb asset/sha as the docx manifest), verified via search API before (count 1, no match) and after (count 2, rank 1). Part 2: GSC service-account POST url:index inspection for 5 URLs (all NEUTRAL/not-indexed), curl with Googlebot UA against zovo.one homepage (0 mcp.zovo.one references in raw HTML -- SPA, negative finding), IndexNow ping for the 5 URLs (HTTP 200). Part 3: registry re-probe of 20 tokens (19 from R6 + estimate) before and after the variant publish, findable share 0.1053 -> 0.1652 using the organic.json formula.
result_schema.failures: none blocking; two negative findings recorded (SPA homepage has no crawlable mcp.zovo.one anchor; all 5 GSC-inspected URLs remain unindexed)
result_schema.insight: The templates registry slot, empty at count 1 in R6, is now filled and ranks 1st of 2 immediately post-publish -- the emptiest-slot strategy from R6 part 3 worked exactly as scored. Separately, the zero-impressions finding from R6 has a likely root cause: zovo.one's own homepage, the natural internal-link source for mcp.zovo.one, renders its links client-side only, so Googlebot's first-pass HTML fetch sees no path from the flagship domain into the MCP storefront at all -- consistent with 179 live pages and zero measured impressions.
